{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wool crepe trousers, straight leg, full length, charcoal grey (#3A3D42), lined wool blend

Fine-knit turtleneck sweater, slim cut, hip length, ivory (#F2EDE3), merino wool

Textured blazer, single-breasted, tailored fit, hip length, heather grey-brown (#8A7F76), wool tweed

Heavy wool coat, straight cut, knee length, camel (#B98E5E), wool-cashmere blend

Ankle boots, block heel, round toe, dark brown (#3B2A22), waterproof leather with a grippy rubber sole

Wool scarf, wide and soft, oatmeal (#D8CBB5), brushed wool

Leather gloves, short cuff, dark brown (#3B2A22), cashmere lining

Structured tote bag, medium size, dark brown (#3B2A22), grained leather

Why this outfit works: it stays within neat business dress, with a refined knit, tailored trousers and a textured jacket, all in a calm palette of greys, ivory and brown. The merino turtleneck, blazer and long coat layer up for frosty autumn mornings, while the scarf and lined gloves protect against the cold on the walk to the office. The block-heel ankle boots with a rubber sole give steady footing on cold, possibly slippery pavement and keep the look polished. Once you are inside, the coat, scarf and gloves come off and the knit and blazer still look professional at your desk."}
